name: Starville
source:
In Starville you'll take on the role of a lynx (Dylan) who due to his past, chooses to move to a new place in the hope of having a better life. 

[From [url=https://mister-gato.itch.io/starville]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Starville》中，你将扮演一只名叫迪伦的猞猁。他因过往经历而选择搬到新的地方，希望能过上更好的生活。

[来源：[url=https://mister-gato.itch.io/starville]Itch.io[/url]]
